products.name: Acefast W7 Earbuds
products.description:
Acefast W7 TWS Earbuds

The Acefast W7 TWS Earbuds bring smart audio technology into a compact design. These Bluetooth earbuds feature a 13mm dynamic driver for powerful, detailed sound. AI call noise cancelling keeps conversations clear in noisy environments. An ultra low latency gaming mode reduces lag during intense gaming sessions. Bluetooth v6.0 delivers faster, more stable connections than older versions. Users get up to 24 hours of total playback time. This combination of features makes the W7 a practical choice for calls, music, and gaming alike.

Bluetooth Connectivity and Audio Protocol

Acefast W7 wireless earbuds run on Bluetooth v6.0 for quick, reliable pairing. They support SBC and AAC audio decoding protocols for smooth playback. The transmission distance extends up to 10 meters without interruption. These TWS earbuds operate within the 2400 to 2483.5 MHz frequency band. This setup ensures steady performance across most modern smartphones and tablets.

AI Call Noise Cancelling and ENC Technology

These Acefast W7 Bluetooth Earbuds use AI-powered call noise cancelling for clearer conversations. Environmental Noise Cancellation, or ENC, filters out background sounds automatically. This technology helps reduce wind noise, traffic sounds, and crowd chatter. Callers hear a clean, focused voice even in busy locations. The AI system adjusts in real time based on surrounding noise levels.

Driver, Sensitivity, and Sound Performance

Each W7 Wireless earbuds contains a 13mm dynamic driver for rich, full-bodied sound. Sensitivity reaches 115 dB ± 3 dB, delivering strong volume output. Frequency response spans from 20Hz to 20kHz, covering a wide sound range. This range supports deep bass, clear vocals, and crisp treble tones. The ultra low latency gaming mode syncs audio closely with on-screen action.

Battery Life and Charging Details

The Acefast W7 Earbuds charging case holds a 320 mAh battery rated at 3.7V. This case provides up to three full charges for the In-Ear TWS earbuds. Each earbud carries a 35 mAh battery, also rated at 3.7V. In music mode, In-Ear Wireless earbuds last about 6 hours at 50 percent volume. Talk mode offers around 3 hours of continuous use at the same volume. Combined with the case, total playback time reaches about 24 hours. The case charges fully in about 1.5 hours, matching the earbuds charging time. A USB Type-C port supports DC5V/0.2A input for simple charging.

Build Quality, Size, and Weight

The Acefast W7 earbuds use durable ABS material for long-lasting use. This material keeps the earbuds sturdy while maintaining a lightweight feel. The overall unit measures 61 x 46 x 27mm, fitting easily into bags or pockets. Total weight comes in at about 140 grams for the complete set. These wireless earbuds carry an IPX4 waterproof rating, resisting sweat and splashes.

Certifications and Safety Compliance

The Acefast W7 earbuds meet multiple international safety and quality standards. They hold CE certification, confirming compliance with European safety regulations. ROHS certification confirms the product avoids hazardous substances during manufacturing. EAC certification supports compliance across Eurasian Economic Union markets. UN38.3 certification applies to safe lithium battery transport standards. The product also includes MSDS documentation for material safety details. Air and sea freight reports support safe international shipping practices. These certifications give buyers confidence in safety, quality, and global compliance.

products.name: Joyroom JR-T04s TWS Bluetooth Earbuds
products.description:
Joyroom JR-T04s TWS Bluetooth Earbuds

The JR-T04S TWS is designed to look like the Apple AirPods with some slight differences. It is made of plastic with a glossy white finish. Even the charging case has a similar shape. The earphones have an open design with a flat stem. These aren't in-ears. It sits in your ear, as opposed to being plugged in. Each earpiece has a multifunction button, a microphone, and speaker vents. The material and design make these quite light and comfortable to wear. They are snug, but some may struggle with getting a good fit. I had to adjust mine from time to time to get a good seal.

Performance

The JR-T04S connects to devices using Bluetooth 5. It has a stable connection, with low latency and little lag. Pairing the JR-T04S is pretty straightforward. As soon as you take it out of the case, each side automatically pairs with the other. From there, you just pair them to your device as you would any other Bluetooth earphones. The multi-function buttons on either side are for controls. Press and hold the right button to play the next song, and the left button to go back to the previous song. Press quickly for play or pause. To answer or reject calls, press any of the buttons. Double-press either button to activate either Siri or Google Assistant.

Audio Quality

Audio quality is where the JR-T04S truly shines. The earphones come with 13mm dynamic drivers, offering audio performance way above their price point. Provided you get a good seal, you'll be surprised at how good these sound. I was impressed, considering these cost less than PHP 1.5k. The earphones have good bass with above-average mids and crisp highs. Clarity is above average, with acceptable separation and a semi-wide soundstage.

Battery Life

The Joyroom JR-T04S comes with a 45 mAh battery per earpiece. The charging case has 500 mAh. Battery life is average, lasting up to 3 hours of playback. The case provides up to 20 hours of playback. It takes 2 hours to charge the earphones to full capacity. The case charges 100% in less than 3 hours. The Joyroom JR-T04s comes with no warranty.
